job.job_description:
We're Hiring at Gradious.ai!




We're expanding our AI team and looking for passionate professionals ready to build the future of Generative AI & Agentic AI.




Job Location: Hyderabad.

Experience: 3 to 8 years

Mode: Work From Office

Time: 10 AM - 7 PM

Compensation: As per market standards




About Gradious

Gradious Technologies is a fast-growing company operating across two high-impact verticals:




EdTech Division: Gradious is an outcome-based ed-tech platform designed for anyone eager to upskill from industry veterans. We run high-impact coding bootcamps for our customer companies and offer our LMS to engineering colleges across India to empower their students with real-world, job-ready skills.




AI Services Division: We build cutting-edge AI solutions and custom software for businesses, focusing on Generative AI, enterprise automation, and next-gen digital platforms.




About the Role:

We are seeking highly skilled Software Development Engineers (SDEs) and Technical Leads / Engineers with deep expertise in Agentic AI and the end-to-end development of AI agents for business applications. In this pivotal role, you will drive the design, implementation, and optimization of Conversational and Intelligent AI Agents that automate, enhance, and transform business processes across the organization.




Key Responsibilities

Design, architect, and develop advanced Conversational AI agents and intelligent automation workflows.

Build, deploy, and optimize AI agents using leading AI platforms (e.g., Kore.ai, n8n, AgentForce).

Integrate and fine-tune LLMs and AI models (e.g., OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, Microsoft Azure AI, Amazon Bedrock, Anthropic Claude, Hugging Face) to deliver scalable solutions.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business needs and translate them into AI-powered automation solutions.

Lead the end-to-end lifecycle of AI agent development from requirement analysis to deployment and monitoring.

Ensure security, scalability, and reliability of deployed AI agents.

Stay up-to-date with the latest AI/ML frameworks, tools, and industry best practices.




Required Skills

Strong programming experience in Python, Node.js with hands-on experience in API development & integration.

Proven expertise in building and deploying RAG, Conversational AI agents, chatbots, or intelligent automation systems.

Deep knowledge of LLMs, prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and embeddings.

Experience with cloud AI services (AWS, GCP, Azure) and scalable deployment frameworks.

Relevant experience in working with Kore.ai platforms is required.

Familiarity with workflow automation platforms and agent orchestration.

Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to design business-driven AI solutions.

Excellent communication and leadership skills.




Good to Have

Experience in vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS).

Exposure to MLOps and CI/CD for AI solutions.

Prior work in domain-specific AI agent development (finance, healthcare, customer support, etc.
